verdict.rationale: Foreloop ships an official JS package you bundle into your app and call with `initForeloopFeedback({ apiKey, reporterName })`, which is a first-party SDK, but it is scoped to embedding the feedback widget. Programmatic access to projects, intentions and tasks otherwise goes through the CLI (with stable `--json` output) and an MCP endpoint, not a general-purpose SDK. Missing for 10: an official general API SDK for core objects (projects, loops, intentions, tasks), multi-language SDK coverage, SDK reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
